metadata.description: Starter Core, Website Builder and App Builder local candidates. Install Core explicitly before either builder.

plugins.name: dlag-starter-core
plugins.description: Starter Build Studio: shared Core plus React Router SSR, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, R2, transactional Resend and Tailwind/shadcn design Playbooks.

plugins.name: dlag-starter-website-builder
plugins.description: Starter Website Builder: authorized React Router SSR websites, repository-managed content, lead capture and SEO. Requires Starter Core.

plugins.name: dlag-starter-app-builder
plugins.description: Starter App Builder: React Router apps, scoped data UI, onboarding, search, integrations and optional hosted Stripe. Requires Starter Core.
